process.title: Your path to working together
process.intro: It starts with a free, no-obligation intro call.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.text: Via the form, email or phone. I get back to you personally within one working day and we set a date.

call.title: Free intro call
call.text: About 30 minutes, no obligation. Where do you stand today, and what is your goal?

proposal.title: Analysis and proposal
proposal.text: I assess your situation and requirements and send a fixed proposal with audit plan or training agenda.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.text: Audit or training on site or remote, with a report and recommended actions.
